description: This file defines the ProvinceCode validation rule class used within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It extends AbstractRule, uses dependency injection to access services, and validates if a given input is a valid province code by interfacing with the CountryService.

classes.name: ProvinceCode
classes.description: A validation rule class that checks if a given province code exists within the system using the CountryService.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates whether the input is a string and corresponds to an existing province code by querying the CountryService.
